characterList.description: A bald man wearing a light purple button-down shirt with a brown tie and a headset microphone. He is the speaker at a conference.
characterList.name: Brian Greenough

characterList.description: A blonde woman with short hair wearing a brown vest. She introduces Brian at the beginning and shakes his hand.
characterList.name: Woman

content_metadata.description: A thoughtful analysis of ethical considerations and effective altruism as discussed by Brian Greenough, referencing Peter Singer's philosophical ideas, presented in a conference setting.

qAndA.question: What color is the tie Brian is wearing?
What is the name of Peter Singer's book?

What foundation does Brian donate to?

qAndA.answer: Brian's talk starts with curiosity and intrigue, leading into a contemplative and pensive mood, ultimately concluding with a sense of responsibility and a call to action.
qAndA.question: What is the overarching mood of Brian's talk?

mood.description: Neutral - Curious: The title card generates curiosity about the topic and speaker.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduces the speaker and the topic of the talk.

videoEditingDetails.description: Title card with speaker name, topic, event location, and date.

activities.description: Woman introduces Brian and shakes his hand. Brian walks to the podium.
Woman shakes Brian's hand again as he leaves the podium.

characterInteraction.description: Polite and professional exchange between Woman and Brian as she introduces him.
Another brief professional exchange as Brian concludes his talk.

mood.description: Neutral - Curious, transitions to Neutral - Pensive at the end.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Shift in visual from graphs to personal picture creates a more intimate and reflective mood.
Call to action in audio leads to a more pensive mood.

narrativeProgression.description: Brian shares his personal journey of growth as an expat and discusses the ethical considerations of living in a developing country, referencing Peter Singer's work.
Brian challenges the audience to consider their own actions.

scenes.thematicElements: Ethical considerations of wealth disparity, Effective altruism, Personal responsibility towards global poverty
scenes.title: Main Talk

videoEditingDetails.description: Simple cuts between the speaker and the slides.

storylines.description: Living Ethically as an Expat in a Developing Country
